entry.title: SVG slots and foreign child placement

content.markdown:
SVG support is opt-in: the consumer registers `createSvgTemplateRenderer` with `SvgTemplateAssetRegistry`; `svg_template` is not in `defaultRenderers`. It supports fixed-arity templates. Formula embedding requires the admitted `formula_embed` metric policy; a failed asset/policy has a visible fallback.

The `svg_template` renderer projects ordinary child trees into SVG slots. A slot index addresses the original child array. Valid indices may be omitted or repeated; indices outside the admitted arity are invalid. Each repeated placement needs its own rendering/lifecycle identity, but all placements of one child retain that child's canonical semantic tree path.

Formula, text and block children must go through the normal child-rendering mechanism. Children are semantic trees, never string-interpolated HTML/SVG. A host-supplied SVG asset loader, sanitized template, and actual geometry are separate prerequisites.

Formula-embedded SVGs participate in KaTeX/ForeignBox sizing. Ordinary block SVGs retain their intrinsic canvas contract rather than being silently squeezed until labels overlap. Test actual placement, clipping, baselines, narrow containers, repeated-slot hover and teardown, not just slot-count metadata.

The SVG asset/template contract does not promise that arbitrary external images, fonts or URLs will become self-contained in an exported HTML file. Offline asset closure and export settlement belong to the exporting consumer and require separate end-to-end tests.

## Per-template intrinsic block width

`template.svg_template` is a consumer-owned object admitted only in block mode. Basics owns its optional `block_width_px`: omission (or an absent runtime value) means exactly 680 CSS pixels; an explicit value must be a finite number greater than zero and at most 4096, including fractional values. Null, strings, non-finite numbers, zero, negative values and values over 4096 are invalid. Other SVG projection fields remain consumer-owned and must survive localization/migration unchanged. Every invariant and localized template projection must satisfy this contract. No schema-version or identity migration is required.

Ordinary block and popover surfaces use this width as their natural canvas width. Height follows the sanitized artwork viewBox aspect ratio; narrow containers scroll rather than squeeze the canvas or independently scale child labels. Width-only projection updates must resize and remeasure slot placements without reacquiring an unchanged asset or replacing stable artwork/semantic child identities. The CSS canvas token is `--snl-svg-template-block-width`; do not set unconditional inline width/height that overrides formula placement.

Formula-embedded SVG dimensions, baseline and reserved KaTeX geometry are determined solely by `formula_embed` and viewBox, not by `block_width_px`. A valid block width must not alter formula metrics or the formula surface dimensions. The opt-in renderer, accessibility, per-consumer sanitization, settled ForeignBox DOM mutation idempotence and unified SNLBasics Library contracts remain unchanged.
